scope.pureFunctions: canRun(snapshot, action) → CanRunResult; next(snapshot) → PolicyResult (action | owner-decision | blocked); diagnose(snapshot) → BlockedDiagnosis. All pure, stateless, I/O-free, read FormalFactSnapshot only.
scope.lineage: Reviewed-Run lineage by reviewedRunId (D1-8): currentArtifactRun (latest completed {S, revise-S}), currentReview (latest completed review-S + verdict), lineageMatch (review.reviewedRunId == artifact.runId). Replaces existence-based rule; correctly closes the cr→revise→review loop.
scope.stageDetection: detectStage(runs, changeId) → explore|propose|apply|archive from Run history (newest-first), with failed/cancelled latest Run → same-action retry (6.11).
scope.preconditionMatrix: 12 formal Actions semantic preconditions returning unmetPreconditions; conflicts fail-closed (D1-3) override all.
scope.unifiedEntry: resolveReview/resolveRevise determine stage S then delegate to canRun(review-S)/revise-S; review and revise are not formal Actions themselves.
scope.ownerDecisionBoundary: owner-decisions (activate-change, authorize-apply/archive/full-test/delivery-finalize/checkpoint) strictly distinct from blocked (D1-9); not auto-advanceable (D1-5).
scope.forwardCompatibleGates: D1-7 (Verification facts unavailable) and D1-11 (Tasks facts unavailable) return blocked in D1; isVerificationFactAvailable/isTasksFactAvailable always false — no inference from Run history / OpenSpec artifacts / chat.
